SchemePolicyName: Andhra Pradesh MSME & Entrepreneur Development Policy, 4.0 (2024-29)

MSME Facilitation: Support at all stages of the business cycle, access to information, and ease of doing business.
Incubation & Acceleration: Build infrastructure and provide mentorship, focusing on early-stage startups and rural entrepreneurs.
Unit Competitiveness: Offer incentives for innovation, skilling, and quality upgrades.
Access to Finance: Facilitate loans, credit guarantees, and support for distressed MSMEs.
Sustainability & Circularity: Promote energy efficiency, renewable energy, and green technology adoption.
Import Substitution & Export Promotion: Enhance MSME export competitiveness and encourage manufacturing of previously imported goods
Cluster-Based Infrastructure: Develop MSME parks with plug-and-play facilities and common resources.
Inclusive Ecosystem: Encourage participation from women, SC/ST, BC, and differently-abled entrepreneurs.
Capital Subsidy: Up to 25% of the fixed capital investment for new enterprises, with additional benefits for disadvantaged groups.
Power Cost Reimbursement: INR 1 per unit for up to six years.
Technology Upgradation: Support up to 20% of fixed costs for equipment upgrades.
Water/Energy Audits: Reimbursement of audit costs and equipment for conservation measures.
Export Incentives: Subsidies for local procurement and quality certification.
Ratan Tata Innovation Hubs: Five hubs linked to a central unit to drive MSME innovation, skilling, and exports.
E-commerce & Digital Transformation: Support for onboarding onto digital platforms and export promotion.

OrganizationName: Information Technology, Electronics & Communications (Promotion wing) Department
SchemePolicyName: AP Semiconductor and Display Fab Policy (4.0)

1. Financial Support:: - Capital subsidies for projects under the Indian Semiconductor Mission (ISM).
- Special power subsidies for non-ISM projects at ₹3/unit for five years.
- Tailor-made benefits for mega (₹1,000–₹5,000 crores) and ultra-mega (₹5,000+ crores) projects.
2. Infrastructure Development:: - Creation of industrial-quality cleanrooms, uninterrupted power supply, and free trade zones.
- Support for industrial water supply, storm drains, and employee living facilities.
3. Talent Development:: - Establishment of an R&D hub for electronics in Visakhapatnam.
- Collaboration with universities to design industry-aligned curriculums.
- Grants for universities to align with national and state policies.
4. Ease of Doing Business:: - Single-window clearances via the State Investment Promotion Board (SIPB) and Committee (SIPC).
5. Customized Incentives:: - Specific benefits based on the project's gestation, technology, and contribution to the state’s growth.
6. Policy Longevity:: - Valid for five years, with provisions for amendments and extensions to ensure sustained support.

SchemePolicyName: Andhra Pradesh Policy for establishment of Private Industrial Parks with 'Plug and Play' Industrial Infrastructure (4.0) 2024-29

Attraction of Investments:: The policy aims to create world-class industrial parks with plug-and-play infrastructure to attract both domestic and international investments.
Job Creation:: It focuses on generating employment by promoting industrial growth and establishing a conducive environment for business operations
Comprehensive Infrastructure Support:: The policy provides complete infrastructure within industrial parks, including roads, drainage, streetlights, water and power distribution, and communication networks, making it easier for businesses to set up quickly.
Land and Layout Incentives:: Offers up to 100% exemption on land conversion charges, change of land use, layout approvals, and stamp duty to incentivize the establishment of industrial parks.
Capital Subsidies:: Developers are eligible for capital subsidies (up to INR 5 lakhs per acre for MSME parks) released in phases based on development milestones.
Support for Sector-Specific Parks:: Encourages the establishment of parks for sectors like biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, electric vehicles, food processing, and more, catering to evolving industrial needs.
Fast-Track Approvals:: Streamlines the process for approvals and clearances with a dedicated Single Window facility, expediting project development and implementation.
Flexible Development Models:: Provides multiple models for industrial park development, including private ownership, joint ventures, and partnerships with the government.
Sustainability and Social Infrastructure: Supports the development of green and sustainable infrastructure, such as zero liquid discharge plants, and encourages building housing and social amenities near industrial parks.
Institutional Support and Coordination:: Facilitates coordination among various government departments to support external infrastructure development and ensure efficient policy implementation.

SchemePolicyName:
New Andhra Pradesh Food Processing Policy
(4.0) 2024-29

Economic Growth:: Aims to attract new investments worth INR 30,000 crores and create 300,000 additional employment opportunities by 2029, establishing Andhra Pradesh as a premier food processing hub.
Incentives for Investment:: Offers extensive fiscal incentives, such as capital subsidies, power tariff reimbursements, SGST reimbursements, and support for skill development and technology upgradation.
Support for MSMEs and Entrepreneurs:: Emphasizes tailored support for micro, small, and medium enterprises, including capacity building, risk management, and infrastructure access.
Infrastructure Development:: Plans for new food parks, nano food parks, cold storage facilities, animal feed parks, and modern abattoirs to boost infrastructure and efficiency.
Sustainability Initiatives:: Focuses on reducing post-harvest losses, promoting waste processing, developing organic production, and encouraging environmentally sustainable practices.
Enhanced Market Access:: Establishes export hubs and promotes the adoption of technology for quality certification, traceability, and food safety to facilitate global market penetration.
Focus on Value Addition:: Encourages secondary and tertiary processing to improve product quality, market competitiveness, and profitability for stakeholders.

SchemePolicyName:
New Andhra Pradesh Industrial
Development Policy (4.0) 2024-29

1. Investment Incentives:: - Capital subsidies ranging from 12% to 15% of Fixed Capital Investment (FCI) for various project sizes.
- Tailor-made benefits for mega and ultra-mega projects, addressing specific investment needs.
2. Employment Creation Support:: - Subsidies based on the employment-to-investment ratio, rewarding projects creating significant job opportunities.
- Support for industrial housing facilities to improve workforce living conditions.
3. Ease of Doing Business:: - Enhanced Single Desk Portal (SDP) for faster approvals and tracking across 19 departments.
- Investment facilitation cells and liaison officers to assist investors throughout the project lifecycle.
4. Cost Reductions:: - Fixed power cost reimbursements and decarbonization subsidies.
- Rationalization of tariffs, duties, and land conversion charges.
- Support for efficient logistics infrastructure to minimize operating costs.
5. Export and Local Procurement Support:: - Reimbursement of 1% of annual export turnover for export-oriented units.
- Net SGST reimbursement for products manufactured and sold within the state.
6. Support for MSMEs and Startups:: - Dedicated policies for MSMEs and entrepreneurs, including financial aid, R&D incentives, and technology transfer support.
- Development of 175 MSME parks with plug-and-play infrastructure.
7. Green Initiatives:: - Emphasis on green energy transition and circular economy principles.
- Subsidies for renewable energy and resource efficiency measures.
8. Special Packages for Early Bird Proje: - Enhanced subsidies of 30-40% of FCI for early project approvals and setup.
9. Infrastructure and Connectivity:: - Development of industrial corridors and ports, enhancing trade logistics.
- Support for inland waterways and freight corridors to reduce transportation costs.
10. Global Integration and FDI Attractio: - Efforts to position Andhra Pradesh as a gateway to Eastern markets.
- Provisions for attracting Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) in emerging sectors.
